    How it works

    We check candidates from several sources through a real WireGuard tunnel and HTTPS traffic. Working endpoints join the pool of fresh addresses (ACTIVE).

    1. CandidateIP:Port from sources
    2. WireGuard handshakeConnection check
    3. Tunnel WARPTunnel setup
    4. HTTPS trafficAccess check
    5. ACTIVEJoins the pool

    Verification is performed from the project server and does not guarantee availability from your network.

    About Endpoint Lab

    Endpoint Lab tests real WARP endpoints through a WireGuard tunnel and HTTPS traffic. Only fresh, successfully verified endpoints join the ACTIVE pool.

    Verification is performed from the project server and confirms the endpoint works from the Lab, but does not guarantee it is reachable from your network.
